# Tasks - Merchant Management

## Backend Tasks

- [ ] 1. Create DTOs for Merchant management
  - File: `backend/src/main/java/com/hzcu/order/dto/CreateMerchantRequest.java`, `backend/src/main/java/com/hzcu/order/dto/MerchantAccountDTO.java`
  - Define `CreateMerchantRequest` with canteen and account fields.
  - Define `MerchantAccountDTO` for displaying account info.
  - _Requirements: 1, 2_
  - _Prompt: Role: Java Backend Developer | Task: Create CreateMerchantRequest and MerchantAccountDTO classes in com.hzcu.order.dto package based on the design document. | Success: DTOs compile and match design specs._

- [ ] 2. Update EntityMapper with MerchantAccount mappings
  - File: `backend/src/main/java/com/hzcu/order/dto/EntityMapper.java`
  - Add mapping methods for `MerchantAccount` to `MerchantAccountDTO`.
  - _Leverage: `backend/src/main/java/com/hzcu/order/entity/MerchantAccount.java`_
  - _Requirements: 2_
  - _Prompt: Role: Java Developer | Task: Add toDto mapping for MerchantAccount in EntityMapper interface. | Success: MapStruct generates the mapper implementation without errors._

- [ ] 3. Extend AdminController with merchant management endpoints
  - File: `backend/src/main/java/com/hzcu/order/controller/AdminController.java`
  - Implement `createMerchant`, `getCanteenAccounts`, and `resetMerchantPassword`.
  - _Leverage: `backend/src/main/java/com/hzcu/order/service/CanteenService.java`, `backend/src/main/java/com/hzcu/order/service/MerchantAccountService.java`_
  - _Requirements: 1, 2, 3_
  - _Prompt: Role: Spring Boot Developer | Task: Add POST /merchants, GET /merchants/{canteenId}/accounts, and PATCH /merchants/accounts/{accountId}/password endpoints to AdminController. Ensure @PreAuthorize("hasRole('ADMIN')") is applied. | Success: Endpoints are functional and protected by admin role._

- [ ] 4. Implement merchant creation logic in services
  - File: `backend/src/main/java/com/hzcu/order/service/MerchantAccountService.java` or `MerchantService.java`
  - Implement transactional logic to create `Canteen` and `MerchantAccount` together.
  - Implement password reset logic with hashing.
  - _Requirements: 1, 3_
  - _Prompt: Role: Java Backend Developer | Task: Implement the business logic for creating a merchant (canteen + account) and resetting passwords in the service layer with transactional support. | Success: Transactions roll back on failure, passwords are hashed._

## Frontend Tasks

- [ ] 5. Update API client with admin merchant endpoints
  - File: `web/lib/api.ts`
  - Add `createMerchant`, `getMerchantAccounts`, and `resetMerchantPassword` to the `api.admin` object.
  - _Requirements: 1, 2, 3_
  - _Prompt: Role: Frontend Developer | Task: Update the api object in lib/api.ts to include the new admin merchant endpoints. | Success: API client supports all new backend endpoints._

- [ ] 6. Implement "Add Merchant" Modal
  - File: `web/app/admin/dashboard/canteens/AddMerchantModal.tsx`
  - Create a form-based modal for canteen and account details.
  - _Leverage: `web/app/admin/dashboard/canteens/page.tsx` styles_
  - _Requirements: 1_
  - _Prompt: Role: Frontend Developer | Task: Create a React modal component for adding a new merchant with form validation. | Success: Modal opens correctly and submits data to the backend._

- [ ] 7. Implement "Merchant Accounts" View Modal
  - File: `web/app/admin/dashboard/canteens/MerchantAccountsModal.tsx`
  - Display a list of accounts for a canteen with a password reset button.
  - _Requirements: 2, 3_
  - _Prompt: Role: Frontend Developer | Task: Create a modal to list merchant accounts for a selected canteen and provide a password reset action. | Success: Admin can view accounts and trigger password reset._

- [ ] 8. Integrate modals into Canteens Management Page
  - File: `web/app/admin/dashboard/canteens/page.tsx`
  - Replace the "coming soon" alert with the new modal.
  - Add a button to each row to view accounts.
  - _Requirements: 1, 2_
  - _Prompt: Role: Frontend Developer | Task: Integrate AddMerchantModal and MerchantAccountsModal into the main canteens page and update the table actions. | Success: All merchant management features are accessible from the UI._
